errata relevant to your system have been applied.

portal_description:
Rhythmbox is an integrated music management application based on the
GStreamer media framework.

This updated package upgrades Rhythmbox to version 0.11.6, and has been
re-licensed to GPLv2 plus exception to allow linking to third-party codecs,
such as those provided by Fluendo.

Users of rhythmbox should upgrade to this updated package.
